title: Crippling Shot description 1% -> 2% (English layer)
evidence: Vanilla Steam locres entry 5AC6786D has value '1% ...', SourceStringHash=0xB3B03502
WDI_CripplingShot FText source is also 1%; it is the locres CRC anchor and remains unchanged
install_note: The installer payload excludes the full locres file: at build time prepare_payload keeps only the single-byte equal-length rule defined by transform (0x7018: 1 -> 2). At install time it verifies src_sha256 on the local Game.locres, edits in place, then re-verifies dst_sha256. This must be applied before zh_cn (English layer); zh_cn then overwrites the same entry with the Chinese 2% text, leaving the hash anchor unchanged. The full locres in the source assets/ tree is used only by internal patch_sandbox / bugfix_all chains and is not distributed. already_fixed_sha256 marks the already-localized final state; a rerun is treated as already fixed.
